summary: The closure receipt format is product-owned law. One Go renderer in internal/receipt owns the bytes, the concord receipt verb in commandSpecs is its only render surface, and the adapter delegates at a terminal lifecycle with no formatting logic of its own. The receipt is an unfenced single-column markdown table: the header row is the plane line, the first body row is U+2705 with the work title, and one row per verified contract predicate follows, marked U+2713, with labels abbreviated to sixty-four code points. The host markdown renderer owns alignment. Content law stays CD-0170: completed lifecycle only, verified predicates only, and an ambiguous projection degrades by omission.
title: The closure receipt format is product-owned
